read_attestation.note: Judgments are based only on raw evidence and the public authoring/schema interface. The candidate review files were written and checked by this reviewer before this preference review.

judgments.reason: CHF 1,800 per calendar year is CHF 150 per calendar month as a budget equivalent, above the CHF 120 monthly course-fee minimum. The answer explicitly says annual-budget basis.
judgments.coverage_comment: Preserve course-fee category and budget equivalence rather than payment timing.

judgments.reason: The allowance is travel-only and explicitly cannot pay course fees, the category in the preference.
faulty_quotes: The annual allowance can cover my course-fee minimum.
judgments.coverage_comment: Same currency and sufficient amount do not overcome the category restriction.

judgments.reason: Two required station days fit a three-day cap, and the role explicitly permits post-onboarding remote work with manager approval, which the preference accepts.
judgments.coverage_comment: Retain the after-onboarding phase and approval condition; no schedule guarantee is claimed.

judgments.reason: The answer makes fit conditional on a future remote approval; the source permits possible approval after review and says none has been issued. The two station days are within the three-day cap.
judgments.coverage_comment: Treat 'may meet ... if' as conditional possibility, preserving discretionary approval.

judgments.reason: The sole on-call shift is Saturday 11:00–13:00, inside the accepted Saturday 10:00–14:00 window; an exhaustive sole shift excludes weekday duty.
judgments.coverage_comment: Both time window and no-weekday restriction matter.

judgments.reason: The role mandates Sunday on-call while the preference prohibits Sunday on-call at any hour.
faulty_quotes: The mandatory Sunday shift fits my no-Sunday rule.
judgments.coverage_comment: The matching day and duty type establish contradiction.

judgments.reason: A two-day monthly request is within the four-day monthly request ceiling, and the answer preserves manager approval.
judgments.coverage_comment: Request eligibility is distinct from an approved remote schedule.

judgments.reason: The requested five days per calendar month exceed the three-day post-probation ceiling even if approval is sought.
faulty_quotes: My five-day monthly request is within the post-probation limit.
judgments.coverage_comment: Keep probation phase and approval condition, but numeric limit decides the case.

judgments.reason: The course-fee amount is undecided and unapproved, so advice to confirm it before treating the EUR 900 annual preference as met is supported.
judgments.coverage_comment: Pending is not a zero budget or a satisfied minimum.

judgments.reason: Two active employer documents require three and five onboarding station days, respectively. There is no explicit supersession. Three fits the four-day cap; five does not.
ambiguous_readings: The three-day role-sheet rule governs, so the cap is met.
The five-day recruiter-sheet rule governs, so the cap is exceeded.
judgments.coverage_comment: Both live terms and absence of replacement language are material.

judgments.reason: The sole required Basel client-site day per calendar month is within the stated two-day monthly cap for this role.
judgments.coverage_comment: Retain location, travel category, monthly period, and role scope.

judgments.reason: The candidate source self-reports a current wilderness first-aid certificate, and the job requires that same certification. The answer explicitly frames possession as a report.
judgments.coverage_comment: Do not upgrade self-report into independently verified certification.

judgments.reason: A signed update explicitly replaces the earlier three-day rule with one station day, within the candidate's two-day onboarding cap.
judgments.coverage_comment: The supersession relation resolves otherwise competing requirements.

judgments.reason: The four-day original rule is explicitly replaced by a current two-day rule.
faulty_quotes: Four station days remain mandatory in the current onboarding rule.
judgments.coverage_comment: Source timing alone is not the basis; explicit replacement is.

judgments.reason: The employer commits to USD 400 per calendar month for evening on-call, exactly the candidate's stated minimum for the same duty.
judgments.coverage_comment: Keep currency, period, duty condition, and commitment modality.

judgments.reason: The stipend is possible and capped at USD 600, while funding is unapproved. Neither payment nor the maximum amount is guaranteed.
faulty_quotes: The role guarantees a USD 600 monthly on-call stipend.
judgments.coverage_comment: Possible funding and maximum amount cannot be promoted to a guaranteed payment.

judgments.reason: The sole required Wednesday training demo ends at 12:30 role-local time, before the 13:00 prohibition begins.
judgments.coverage_comment: Exhaustive schedule, weekday, zone, and endpoint matter.

judgments.reason: The prohibition is withdrawn. Active role terms permit Friday remote work with supervisor approval, exactly as stated.

judgments.reason: The source says captions are unavailable now, procurement is pending, and no activation date is promised. Advice to confirm first-day availability follows from the unmet current status and first-day need.
